rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" sed -i 's@__GNU_LIBRARY__ >= 6@1@g' proc/escape.c
# The build system prefers utmpx.h over utmp.h, but musl's utmp.h includes # utmpx.h. export ac_cv_header_utmpx_h='no'
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-nls
rules.install:
mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/procps" mkdir -p "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sysctl"
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" make DESTDIR="$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/procps" install
install -d -m 0755 "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sysctl/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin" mv "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/procps/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin/sysctl" \ "$AELTRA_INSTALL_DIR/sysctl/$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/sbin"
